scenario.summary: Signs in on the webstore with the class's retail account. First method of the class: declares the account the whole class signs in with.
steps: Sign in with the testClassRetailUsers/quickOrderRetailUserTest username and password
stateChanges: Signed-in webstore session for the account (kept for the class; logged off by pasteMultipleSkusForRetailUserRemoveProductsFromCartAndLoggOff)
evidence: First method of the class (priority 1): signs in and leaves the session for the class; RemoveProductsFromCartAndLoggOff logs it off. It declares its own account need like every other signing-in method of the class (an account lease is held by the declaring method only, so each method declares; coordinator decision 2026-11-05).

DECLARED ACCOUNT: USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting), as the Selenium pilot T01-T04 and the Playwright quick-order retail entries; username/password stay credential sources (masked, loginAndRegistration!B190/C190) the test keeps reading from its own sheet. Quick-order cart lines of later methods go to this account's cart; each method removes them.
Product needs are not declared here: the later methods are independent (each opens Quick Order itself) and declare their own products.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
